guides.intro: What an Enhancement shaman presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Enhancement is the shaman's fastest leveling spec in the fight lab: you walk in, swing a slow weapon, and add a shock and a strike on short cooldowns. Mana goes to shocks, not to Lightning Bolts. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Swing
stages.change: Your weapon and **Rockbiter Weapon** do the work.
press: One **Lightning Bolt** while the mob runs at you, if you like. Mana is no worry yet.
Then swing until it is dead.
notes: Keep **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon at all times. Recast it when it runs out.

stages.title: Earth Shock
stages.change: **Earth Shock**, an instant on a short cooldown. From here on, skip the opening Lightning Bolt.
press: Walk in and swing. No opening Lightning Bolt: its mana costs more drinking than the damage saves.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
notes: **Earth Shock** also interrupts. Use it on a caster's spell and the mob walks to you.
**Stoneskin Totem** (4) and **Earthbind Totem** (6) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lightning Shield
stages.change: **Lightning Shield** on yourself: mobs that hit you take damage. **Stoneclaw Totem** is your first panic button.
press: Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem**. The mob turns on the totem while you cast **Healing Wave**.

stages.title: Searing Totem, and talents begin
stages.change: **Searing Totem** at the pull adds free damage for the whole fight. Talent points start.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** and cast **Healing Wave**.
notes: **Flame Shock** (10) shares its cooldown with **Earth Shock**. Against one mob the fight lab never casts it.
Stay on **Rockbiter Weapon** until level 30. **Flametongue Weapon** (10) is not the leveling imbue.
Use a slow two-handed weapon as soon as you can: every strike and proc scales with the weapon's hit.
**Strength of Earth Totem** (10) and **Fire Nova** (12) cost more mana than they return against one mob.

stages.title: Lesser Healing Wave and Ghost Wolf
stages.change: Nothing new in the fight. **Lesser Healing Wave** is a fast heal, **Ghost Wolf** gets you between mobs sooner.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Ghost Wolf** (20) between pulls and on every walk back from the graveyard.
**Frost Shock** (20) is for a mob that runs away, or to slow one you want to escape. It shares the shock cooldown.

stages.title: Stormstrike
stages.change: **Stormstrike** (talent): an instant weapon strike that also makes your next shocks hit 20% harder.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free. Cast after a **Stormstrike**, it takes the 20% bonus.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Flurry** (26-29, 32) makes you swing faster after every critical hit. Nothing to press.

stages.title: Windfury Weapon
stages.change: **Windfury Weapon** replaces Rockbiter on your weapon: a chance on every hit for extra swings.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: Put **Windfury Weapon** on your weapon the moment you train it, and keep it there to 60.
**Chain Lightning** (32) and **Windfury Totem** (32) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Maelstrom Weapon
stages.change: **Maelstrom Weapon** (talent): your hits build stacks, and at 5 your **Lightning Bolt** is instant.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
With 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: an instant **Lightning Bolt**, once the mob is under 35% of its health.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: The stacks come faster with every point of **Maelstrom Weapon** (35-39). Never cast **Lightning Bolt** with its cast time.
Do not spend the instant bolt on a mob it would overkill.

stages.title: Rage of the Farseer, the finished rotation
stages.change: **Rage of the Farseer** (talent) opens a fight whenever it is ready. Nothing else new: buy every new rank.
press: **Rage of the Farseer** at the start of a fight whenever it is ready.
**Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
Keep **Lightning Shield** up.
With 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: an instant **Lightning Bolt**, once the mob is under 35% of its health.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: The remaining points go to Elemental for cheaper, harder shocks: **Convection** (52-56) and **Concussion** (47-51).

between: Heal back to about 80% of your health with **Lesser Healing Wave** from level 20, or **Healing Wave** for a big gap and before 20.
Eat if you are still under 80% and out of mana for heals. Drink only below about 15% of your mana.
Recast your weapon imbue when it runs out, and **Lightning Shield** before each pull.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of **Earth Shock** and **Lightning Shield**.
other: Elemental is about 16% slower per kill in the fight lab. It plays **Lightning Bolt** from range and is on its own page in this folder.
A shaman who wants to heal at 60 levels fastest as Enhancement and respecs, or levels into the Restoration build shown on its page.
